scripts.build: npm run build:launch && npm run build:mission && npm run build:deps
scripts.build:deps: jq '{dependencies: {pino: .packages["node_modules/pino"].version}}' package-lock.json > dist/package.json && cd dist && npm install --omit-dev --no-package-lock
scripts.postbuild: cp collector.yaml dist/collector.yaml && cd dist && zip -r lambdas.zip ./*
scripts.types: dtsgen --out src/launch/@types/launch.d.ts src/launch/openapi.json && dtsgen --out src/mission/@types/mission.d.ts src/mission/openapi.json
